tldr: 輝達最新季營收 1,158 億美元、年增 103% 優於預期，股價卻由紅翻黑，AI 投資多空持續交戰。
美股續跌，標普 500 連 5 黑，鷹派聯準會會議紀要升高升息疑慮。
台股靠結算軋空小漲 102 點，惟外資連 3 日賣超逾 765 億元。
金管會 6 家「大到不能倒」銀行連 7 年不變，中信信託開放境內 ETF，財政部預告調高遺贈稅免稅額。

items.title_zh: 台股尾盤軋空收漲 102 點
items.title_en: Taiex edges up as futures settlement sparks late short-covering rally
items.summary_zh: 台指期月結算帶動尾盤軋空拉抬，加權指數終場收 40,194.91 點、上漲 102.80 點，成交值約 1 兆 306 億元。權值股台積電尾盤湧入大量買單，收 2,175 元、漲 5 元（+0.23%）；鴻海漲 2 元至 221 元。盤勢在結算與權值股拉抬下翻紅，但量能顯示追價意願仍偏保守。
items.summary_en: The Taiex closed at 40,194.91, up 102.80 points, on turnover of about NT$1.03 trillion, as a short-covering squeeze around the monthly futures settlement lifted the index late in the session. Heavyweight TSMC rose NT$5 to NT$2,175 (+0.23%) on a burst of closing buy orders, while Hon Hai added NT$2 to NT$221.

items.title_zh: 外資連 3 日賣超逾 765 億 調節台積電逾 1.5 萬張
items.title_en: Foreign funds dump over NT$76 billion, trimming TSMC for a third day
items.summary_zh: 外資及陸資單日賣超台股 765.63 億元，為連續第 3 個交易日站在賣方，累計賣超已逾 1,848 億元，其中調節台積電逾 1.5 萬張。不過投信逆勢買超 175.58 億元，三大法人合計賣超 632.07 億元。外資持續調節權值股，顯示法人對短線高檔震盪偏保守，宜留意後續資金流向。
items.summary_en: Overseas and mainland investors sold a net NT$76.56 billion of Taiwan shares, a third straight session of selling that lifts the cumulative outflow past NT$184.8 billion, including more than 15,000 lots of TSMC. Domestic investment trusts bucked the trend with NT$17.56 billion of net buying, leaving the three major institutions net sellers of NT$63.2 billion.

items.title_zh: 台積電供應鏈論壇表揚 35 家供應商創新高
items.title_en: TSMC honors record 35 suppliers at "grand alliance" forum
items.summary_zh: 台積電 11 月 17 日舉辦 2026 年供應鏈管理論壇，以「新時代的大同盟」為主題，共 35 家供應商獲頒卓越表現獎、創歷年新高，漢唐、萬潤、健策等台廠與 ASML、應材等國際設備商入列。執行長魏哲家強調 AI 時代需深化供應鏈合作，為先進製程與產能擴充預作準備。
items.summary_en: At its 2026 Supply Chain Management Forum on Nov 17, themed "Grand Alliance for a New Era," TSMC named a record 35 suppliers for excellence awards, including local firms such as Marketech, Martek and Jentech alongside global tool makers like ASML and Applied Materials. CEO C.C. Wei stressed deepening AI-era collaboration across the chip supply chain.

items.title_zh: 輝達擴大供應鏈合作 點名六家台廠
items.title_en: Nvidia widens Taiwan supply-chain ties, names six partners
items.summary_zh: 輝達宣示擴大與供應鏈合作，台積電、鴻海、矽品、京元電、景碩、欣興等台廠入列。規劃三年內將載板總產能提高至 2.5 倍，並於 2026 至 2027 年間讓半導體測試產能倍增。台積電業務高層表示，合作有助預先規劃技術與製造需求，凸顯台灣在 AI 基建供應鏈的關鍵地位。
items.summary_en: Nvidia pledged expanded cooperation with its supply chain, naming Taiwanese firms TSMC, Hon Hai, SPIL, KYEC, Kinsus and Unimicron. The plan includes lifting total substrate capacity 2.5-fold within three years and doubling semiconductor test capacity in 2026-2027, reinforcing Taiwan's central role in building out AI infrastructure.

items.title_zh: 金管會公布 6 家「大到不能倒」銀行 連 7 年不變
items.title_en: FSC keeps six "too big to fail" banks for a seventh year
items.summary_zh: 金管會公布 2026 年系統性重要銀行（D-SIBs）名單，六家銀行續列、名單連續 7 年未變動。金管會表示，6 家 D-SIBs 的資本適足比率均已符合最終資本要求，第二支柱壓力測試結果也符合標準，顯示大型銀行資本體質穩健，有助強化金融體系抗風險能力。
items.summary_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission released its 2026 list of domestic systemically important banks (D-SIBs), keeping the same six lenders for a seventh straight year. All six already meet the final capital requirements, and their Pillar 2 stress-test results comply with standards, the regulator said, signaling solid capital buffers at Taiwan's largest banks.

items.title_zh: 保險業接軌新制 金管會推多項監理措施
items.title_en: Insurers face new regimes as FSC rolls out oversight measures
items.summary_zh: 國內壽險業今年正式接軌 IFRS 17 與新一代清償能力制度（ICS），金管會因此推動多項監理措施。11 月 16 日舉辦保險業風險管理趨勢論壇，要求業者強化資產負債與資本管理；監理層並從資產、負債與淨值三面向引導壽險業強化體質，確保接軌後清償能力穩定。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's life insurers are adopting IFRS 17 and the new ICS solvency regime this year, prompting the FSC to introduce multiple supervisory measures. At a Nov 16 risk-management forum the regulator pressed insurers to strengthen asset-liability and capital management across assets, liabilities and net worth to withstand the transition.

items.title_zh: 中國信託個人信託升級 可配置境內 ETF
items.title_en: CTBC upgrades personal trusts to hold domestic ETFs
items.summary_zh: 中國信託銀行將個人信託服務大升級，自 2026 年 10 月起把境內 ETF 納入可運用標的，擴大信託資產配置彈性。此舉反映高資產與一般財管客群對 ETF 需求快速升溫，ETF 已成為財富管理核心配置之一。透過信託架構配置 ETF，也有助客戶兼顧資產傳承與靈活投資需求。
items.summary_en: CTBC Bank has upgraded its personal trust service so clients can now allocate to onshore ETFs, effective from October 2026. The move widens the investment menu within discretionary and family trusts, reflecting surging demand for ETFs as a core wealth-management building block among affluent Taiwanese clients seeking both flexibility and succession planning.

items.title_zh: 高資產財管突破 3 兆元 高資產戶年增逾 8 成
items.title_en: High-net-worth wealth assets top NT$3 trillion as rich clients surge
items.summary_zh: 隨財管 2.0 上路滿六年，銀行高資產財富管理規模突破 3 兆元，高資產客戶數年增逾 8 成。配置結構由存款、基金轉向 ETF、海外資產與保險並重；境內基金規模突破 10 兆元，其中 ETF 約占 7.4 兆元。高資產客群跨境布局比例攀升，顯示財富管理市場結構正快速質變。
items.summary_en: Six years into Taiwan's "Wealth Management 2.0" scheme, banks' high-net-worth wealth assets have broken through NT$3 trillion, with the number of high-asset clients jumping more than 80% year-on-year. Portfolios are shifting from deposits and funds toward ETFs, offshore assets and insurance; onshore funds now exceed NT$10 trillion, of which ETFs make up about NT$7.4 trillion.

items.title_zh: 物價漲幅達標 遺產稅免稅額擬升至 1,492 萬、贈與稅 273 萬
items.title_en: Taiwan set to raise estate- and gift-tax exemptions
items.summary_zh: 因 CPI 累計漲幅超過法定門檻，財政部可望調升遺產稅免稅額，由 1,333 萬元升至 1,492 萬元（增 159 萬），贈與稅免稅額由 244 萬元升至 273 萬元。財政部預計年底前公告，調整後門檻適用於 2027 年起發生的繼承與贈與案件，高資產族群傳承規劃可留意額度變化。
items.summary_en: With cumulative CPI gains clearing the statutory threshold, the Ministry of Finance is expected to lift the estate-tax exemption from NT$13.33 million to NT$14.92 million and the gift-tax exemption from NT$2.44 million to NT$2.73 million. The MOF will announce the change by year-end, with the higher thresholds applying to inheritances and gifts occurring from 2027.

items.title_zh: 現行遺贈稅免稅額與級距維持不變
items.title_en: Current estate- and gift-tax brackets unchanged for now
items.summary_zh: 依財政部現行公告，2025 年起發生之繼承與贈與案件，遺產稅免稅額為 1,333 萬元、贈與稅免稅額為每人每年 244 萬元，課稅級距維持 10%／15%／20% 三段式。在新調升額度 2027 年上路前，現行標準仍為報稅依據，納稅人規劃贈與與繼承時宜先確認適用年度。
items.summary_en: Under the MOF's standing rules, cases arising from 2025 apply an estate-tax exemption of NT$13.33 million and a gift-tax exemption of NT$2.44 million per person per year, with a three-tier 10%/15%/20% rate schedule. These brackets remain the basis for filings until the newly announced exemption increases take effect in 2027.

items.title_zh: AI 火力全開 台灣今年經濟成長預測創高
items.title_en: AI boom drives record upgrades to Taiwan's growth forecast
items.summary_zh: 在 AI 供應鏈擴產帶動出口下，官方大幅上修 2026 年經濟成長預測。主計總處將全年 GDP 估值上修至約 11.05%，央行估值更高、近 11.5%，兩者均預期 2027 年成長放緩至約 6%。全年 CPI 預估約 2.07%，通膨仍須留意。結構性出口動能可望延續，但高基期下明年成長料回歸常態。
items.summary_en: Officials have sharply raised Taiwan's 2026 growth outlook as the AI supply-chain build-out powers exports. The DGBAS lifted its full-year GDP forecast to about 11.05%, while the central bank's estimate runs even higher near 11.5%; both see growth cooling to around 6% in 2027. CPI is projected near 2.07% this year, keeping inflation on watch.

items.title_zh: 央行維持利率 2% 升息議題再浮上檯面
items.title_en: Central bank holds rates at 2% as hike talk resurfaces
items.summary_zh: 台灣央行維持重貼現率於 2.0%，此水準已逾兩年未調整。然而隨內需回溫、經濟成長預測在 AI 熱潮下屢次上修，市場對升息的討論再度升溫。央行認為今年通膨大致可控，預期明年有望回降至 2% 以下，後續理監事會動向與物價走勢為觀察重點。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's central bank has kept its benchmark discount rate at 2.0%, a level held for more than two years. But with internal demand warming and growth forecasts repeatedly revised up on the AI boom, market discussion of a possible rate hike has resurfaced, even as the bank judges this year's inflation to remain broadly manageable.

items.title_zh: 大摩：AI 供應鏈修正過度 點名台積電、聯發科逢低買進
items.title_en: Morgan Stanley calls AI supply-chain pullback overdone
items.summary_zh: 台灣媒體報導摩根士丹利觀點，認為近期美國資料中心建置預期的修正屬過度反應，部分專案僅由 2028 年延後至 2029 年，反有助延長 AI 基礎設施建設週期。大摩點名台積電、聯發科為逢跌買進良機，並認為台灣 AI 供應鏈基本面所受實質衝擊有限，提供中長線布局參考。
items.summary_en: Taiwanese media reported Morgan Stanley's view that the recent correction in US data-center build-out expectations is an overreaction, with some projects merely pushed from 2028 to 2029, which could lengthen the AI infrastructure cycle. The bank flagged TSMC and MediaTek as attractive buy-on-dip opportunities, arguing Taiwan's AI supply chain faces limited real impact.

items.title_zh: 亞股 AI 需求信心回升 台日韓股齊漲、港股收跌
items.title_en: Asian markets steady as AI demand confidence returns
items.summary_zh: 根據台灣財經媒體報導，隨市場對 AI 需求信心回升，亞洲主要股市止穩，台股、日股、韓股同步走高，港股則收跌。盤面漲跌互見，反映投資人在 AI 相關獲利仍具韌性，與科技股評價偏高的審慎情緒之間拉鋸，區域資金輪動與美股走勢連動性仍高。
items.summary_en: Regional equities found footing as confidence in AI demand recovered, with Taiwan, Japan and South Korea's benchmarks rising together while Hong Kong stocks slipped, according to Taiwanese market coverage. The mixed session reflected investors weighing resilient AI-related earnings against caution over richly valued technology names.

items.title_zh: 美股收黑 標普連 5 日下跌（2026-11-18）
items.title_en: US stocks close lower as S&P 500 logs fifth straight loss (2026-11-18)
items.summary_zh: 美股週二續挫，道瓊下跌約 561 點（1.1%）收 50,198.17 點，標普 500 跌 0.23% 至 7,323.63 點，為連續第 5 個交易日下跌、創 6 月以來最長連跌。那斯達克逆勢上漲約 0.4%。聯合健康（UnitedHealth）重挫約 6%，為拖累道瓊的主因。
items.summary_en: Wall Street fell again on Tuesday, with the Dow dropping about 561 points (1.1%) to 50,198.17 and the S&P 500 slipping 0.23% to 7,323.63, its fifth consecutive decline and its longest losing streak since June. The Nasdaq bucked the trend, rising about 0.4%. UnitedHealth sank roughly 6%, weighing heavily on the Dow.

items.title_zh: 輝達季營收創高達 1,158 億美元優於預期（2026-11-17）
items.title_en: Nvidia beats with record fiscal-Q3 revenue of $115.8 billion (2026-11-17)
items.summary_zh: 輝達公布 2027 會計年度第 3 季財報，營收 1,158 億美元，年增 103%、季增 20%，優於自估的約 1,080 億美元財測。資料中心營收達 1,076 億美元、年增 110%；GAAP 毛利率 74.8%，GAAP 稀釋後每股盈餘 2.70 美元，顯示 AI 晶片需求依然強勁。
items.summary_en: Nvidia reported third-quarter fiscal 2027 results, with revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103% from a year earlier and 20% sequentially, above its own guidance of about $108 billion. Data-center revenue reached $107.6 billion, up 110% year-on-year, with GAAP gross margin of 74.8% and GAAP diluted EPS of $2.70.

items.title_zh: 鷹派聯準會會議紀要 升高升息疑慮（2026-11-18）
items.title_en: Hawkish Fed minutes stoke fears of more rate hikes (2026-11-18)
items.summary_zh: 美股承壓，最新一次聯準會會議紀要顯示，幾乎所有官員認為進一步升息可能是適當之舉。升息預期蓋過強勁企業財報氛圍，標普 500 跌破包含 200 日均線在內的重要技術支撐，市場對聯準會後續政策路徑轉趨保守，資金自高評價資產撤出。
items.summary_en: US equities came under pressure as minutes from the latest Federal Reserve meeting showed almost all officials judged that further interest-rate increases would likely be appropriate. The S&P 500 broke below key technical support, including its 200-day moving average, as rate-hike expectations overshadowed an otherwise strong corporate-earnings backdrop.

items.title_zh: 油價重挫抵銷輝達賣壓 全球股市震盪（2026-11-18）
items.title_en: Stocks churn as oil slump offsets Nvidia selloff (2026-11-18)
items.summary_zh: 根據市場綜述，全球股市震盪整理，油價下滑抵銷了輝達財報後股價回落的壓力。受與伊朗衝突的不確定性影響，原油當日明顯走低；美國 10 年期公債殖利率回落至約 5.06%，黃金則跌至一年低點。投資人在能源、利率與科技股評價間重新調整配置。
items.summary_en: Global markets were choppy as a slide in oil prices offset pressure from Nvidia's post-earnings decline, according to a markets wrap. Crude fell sharply on the session amid uncertainty over the conflict with Iran, while the US 10-year Treasury yield eased to around 5.06%. Gold slipped to a one-year low.
